title: No new takeaway liquor authorities until after 28 February 2027
what: A business cannot get a new takeaway liquor authority: none may be created or issued until after 28 February 2027, the date set by regulation.

sources.title: Liquor Act 2019 (NT)
sources.quote: (3) No takeaway authority may be created or issued until after 31 August 2023 or any later date extended under subsection (4). (4) The date after which a takeaway authority may be created or issued may be extended by up to 12 months at a time by regulation.

sources.title: Liquor Regulations 2019 (NT)
sources.quote: 98A Extension of date restricting new takeaway authorities For section 84(4) of the Act, the date referred to in section 84(3) of the Act is extended to 28 February 2027.

sources.title: Liquor Act 2019 (NT)
sources.quote: (3) No takeaway authority may be created or issued until after 31 August 2023 or any later date extended under subsection (4). (4) The date after which a takeaway authority may be created or issued may be extended by up to 12 months at a time by regulation.

confidence_note: The Act's own words bar new takeaway authorities; the regulations extend the date.

assessment.summary: No new takeaway liquor licences for two years in the Northern Territory, to reduce alcohol harm. It blocks entry into liquor retailing and protects existing bottle shops.

marks.reason: A moratorium on new takeaway licences blocks entry into liquor retailing.

assessment.confidence_note: Harm reduction, the reason for the policy, is not weighed here. Marks copied from the register item nt-takeaway-liquor-moratorium-2017 so the two agree.
